title: Port the unslop and technical-writing skills
action: Port two pstack skills into this repo. The pstack source is a read-only clone at /tmp/claude-1000/-home-thanhsmind-Projects-goglbe-beehive/9d0933f3-e76c-498c-a471-1b5f7f684697/scratchpad/pstack-src/pstack/skills/ — read unslop/SKILL.md and technical-writing/SKILL.md there in full before writing anything.
